segments.title: Chương 7: 0007【Bạn Cùng Bàn Mới】
segments.content:
"Class 11 is the only advanced liberal arts class in the entire grade. Yet in this midterm exam, three students from the regular classes managed to score in the top ten of the entire grade! Tell me, what's the point of even having this advanced class?"

"I won't announce the overall scores and rankings. They're posted next to the blackboard for you to see for yourselves."

"Zhang Chao," Liu Shuying suddenly called out a name.

"Here!"

A short, chubby boy stood up nervously.

Liu Shuying said, "You've always been in the top eight of the grade, but this time you only got fourteenth."

Zhang Chao lowered his head in shame.

Liu Shuying added, "You're a down-to-earth and hardworking student, so I won't say anything harsh. When the papers for each subject are handed back, you should reflect carefully on your own problems."

"Okay."

Zhang Chao buried his head even lower, as if getting fourteenth in the entire grade was a heinous crime.

With his score, he was definitely within the top fifty in the entire city!

Liu Shuying continued calling out names, "Wei Xiaofeng..."

She called out six students in a row, but Chen Guiliang was not among them.

Chen Guiliang knew very well that since he had only done the multiple-choice questions in math, he would surely be called to have a private chat after class.

After calling the names, Liu Shuying said, "The papers for the other subjects will be handed out tomorrow. For now, come up and get your English tests. Zhou Jing, 131, you've regressed since the monthly exam..."

"Peng Yang, 106. You're very skewed in your subjects. You must shore up your weakness in English."

"Wu Meng, 147, first in the entire grade. Keep it up."

"..."

Finally, it was Chen Guiliang's turn. Liu Shuying only stated his score without comment, "Chen Guiliang, 82."

Chen Guiliang went to get his test paper with a clear conscience.

After passing the College English Test Band 4 in university, he hadn't really touched English. For the next decade or so, the English vocabulary he encountered was basically all work-related. To be able to score 82 after being reborn was something he was already very content with.

But Liu Shuying was especially disappointed in Chen Guiliang.

Xu Haibo scored 130 this time, which was about his normal level.

Xie Yang got 115, which was so-so. When the kid went to get his test paper, he couldn't help but flick his hair.

Guan Zhiqiang came back with his test paper and said cheerfully, "I improved! I went up 5 points from the monthly exam."

Chen Guiliang took a closer look and couldn't help but smile along with him.

Guan Zhiqiang's English score was 58... all one could say was that there was still a lot of room for improvement.

Even as a man on his second life, Chen Guiliang found it truly difficult to imagine what Guan Zhiqiang would be like as a leader at the Academy of Fine Arts.

After the tests were handed out, she began to go over the questions.

Chen Guiliang listened attentively. His problem was that he had neglected English for too long.

He had forgotten the vocabulary, the phrasing, and even the damn grammar.

Li Jun felt his chance had come. He moved his test paper, on which he'd only scored a 34, to the space between their two desks. "Classmate Bian, you don't have a paper, you can use mine to follow along."

"No need," Bian Guanyue refused decisively.

Li Jun, smiling shamelessly, persisted, "Classmates should help each other out."

Bian Guanyue pulled up the hood of her hoodie, obscuring most of her face, and took out her English textbook to memorize vocabulary silently.

Li Jun had hit a wall, and didn't know how to proceed.

He was afraid of leaving a bad impression on Bian Guanyue, so he pretended to listen to the teacher's explanation of the test paper. But he couldn't take anything in at all. Within two minutes, his mind had wandered off, and he sat there with his eyes half-open, dozing off.

Time ticked by, and Liu Shuying finally finished going over the English test.

"Carefully review your own problems. Chen Guiliang, come out for a moment." After saying this, Liu Shuying walked out, intending to have a long, private talk with Chen Guiliang in the hallway.

Guan Zhiqiang pressed down on his novel with one hand and patted Chen Guiliang with the other, as a gesture of comfort.

This guy was actually not a bad person.

Chen Guiliang followed the head teacher out of the room, and the classroom instantly grew a bit noisier. Most students were studying seriously, but a few had started to chat in low voices.

Li Jun took off the MP3 player hanging from his chest and pushed it onto Bian Guanyue's desk, saying, "Want to listen to some music?"

He was both showing off his Meizu MP3 and trying to take the opportunity to listen to music with Bian Guanyue.

Sharing a pair of earphones, one for each person, how romantic, just like a couple.

Bian Guanyue didn't seem to like talking. She reached into her schoolbag, took out an MP3 player, and placed it on her desk to show that she had one too.

Li Jun glanced at the brand: Samsung.

His expression was a little awkward as he silently put away his Meizu.

Still unwilling to give up, Li Jun took out his phone again. "Classmate Bian, what's your phone number?"

Still showing off, and hitting on her at the same time.

His phone was a Sony Ericsson T618. The official price was 3800 yuan, but it actually cost over 4000 yuan to get one's hands on it. It was a hot item, so a premium was required.

"Smack!"

Bian Guanyue had apparently guessed his intentions. She immediately pulled out a bulky "Pang Liu" phone and slapped it right on the desk. "Don't bother me."

A Nokia 6600. The official price was 4680 yuan, even more expensive than his premium-priced Sony Ericsson.

Li Jun was instantly frozen on the spot.

He had a foul mouth and was disliked by others, and his grades weren't good either. He only had two things he could show off: one was that he was tall and good at basketball, and the other was that his family was rich and he wanted for nothing.

Now it was obvious that Bian Guanyue was even richer than him.

He couldn't very well challenge a girl to a one-on-one game of basketball to regain his pride, could he?

Inconspicuously, he stuffed his phone back into his pocket. Li Jun cautiously tested the waters, asking, "Classmate Bian, does your dad do business in Rongcheng?"

Bian Guanyue said, "My dad's in the mafia. He just got out of prison."

With that said, the conversation was dead.

Li Jun was so anxious he was scratching his head. His usual methods for picking up girls had failed, and he really didn't know what to do next.

But he was reluctant to give up, because Bian Guanyue was just too beautiful.

Outside the classroom, in the hallway.

Liu Shuying said with a stern face, "You've caused trouble several times this semester. Under normal circumstances, you should have been persuaded to withdraw or expelled long ago. Do you know why you were only put on probation?"

Chen Guiliang said with sincere gratitude, "Thank you, Teacher Liu, for pleading on my behalf."

But Liu Shuying shook her head. "Me pleading for you with the principal was only a minor factor. The school didn't expel you because your academic performance is still pretty good. You can at least get into a Tier 2 university. With a little effort, you can get into a Tier 1, and if you study seriously, you might even get into a key university."

"Sigh," Chen Guiliang sighed.

Liu Shuying continued, "Before the arts and sciences streams were separated, I taught you English in Class 1. I know how good your entrance exam scores were, 56th in the entire city! You only lost a few points in Chinese, Math, and English. For the other subjects, you got full marks on the high school entrance exam. If you had studied hard from your first year, you could have gotten into Tsinghua or Peking University."

Chen Guiliang let out a hearty laugh. He was still very satisfied with his high school entrance exam results.

Liu Shuying went on, "When the arts and sciences streams were divided, you scored above 95 (out of 100) in both Math and Physics. I don't know why you insisted on choosing the liberal arts stream, but no matter what you choose, you should focus on your studies. You're a student. Why are you always getting involved in all that other nonsense?"

Chen Guiliang was at a loss for words.

Because even he himself felt that his three years of high school were pretty absurd.

But he didn't regret it; he just thought it was ridiculous.

Liu Shuying said, "Li Jun's family has someone who is an official. Guan Zhiqiang's family is in business. Their parents are rich and influential, so no matter how much they mess around and play, they won't have to worry about their future. What about you? A left-behind child. Besides studying hard, what other path do you have to change your life?"

Chen Guiliang completely agreed. "You're right, Teacher."

Liu Shuying said, her heart aching with disappointment, "In the past, even though you often got into trouble and your mind wasn't on your studies, you at least took your exams seriously. But what is this now? You only did the multiple-choice questions in math and turned in your paper. Your English score dropped by more than 30 points, and your combined liberal arts score dropped by more than 50 points. If you keep going on like this, the school really will expel you!"

Chen Guiliang promised, "I will definitely change."

Liu Shuying said, "There's a parent-teacher conference next weekend. You must have your parents come."

Chen Guiliang said, "Teacher Liu, you know my situation. My parents are working out of town. If other relatives come to the conference, it's just a formality. Isn't it better to use the 8 yuan for the round-trip bus fare to eat a couple more meat dishes?"

Liu Shuying was so angered by these words that she laughed. She truly didn't know how to handle this bizarre student.

Chen Guiliang was actually very tired himself. He clearly had the soul of a 40-year-old, but because of all the stupid things he did in high school, he had to pretend to be a little brat and get lectured obediently.

After a few seconds of silence, Liu Shuying said, "You'd better watch yourself. Go get Wang Chunlei."

Chen Guiliang was finally liberated. He walked back to the classroom with a light step and shouted, "Wang Chunlei, Teacher Liu summons you!"

A boy with glasses heard this, his expression tense. He steeled himself and stood up to walk out.

Chen Guiliang returned to his seat and continued to look over his mistakes in the English test.

Who knows what Li Jun had said, but Bian Guanyue stood up impatiently. She saw Guan Zhiqiang drooling as he read his novel, looking foolish and dim-witted, and confirmed that he would be a good deskmate.

And so, Bian Guanyue picked up her schoolbag, walked over to Chen Guiliang, and said, "Excuse me, could we switch seats?"

"No," Chen Guiliang said without lifting his head, continuing to flip through his English test paper.

Bian Guanyue seemed to have misheard. She squeezed out a polite smile. "Thank you."

Chen Guiliang repeated, "I said no."

Bian Guanyue: "..."

In his previous life, Chen Guiliang had foolishly agreed.

If he switched and became deskmates with Li Jun, what was the difference between that and sitting next to a pile of shit? He had been disgusted enough in his last life.

But Bian Guanyue didn't know what Chen Guiliang was thinking. No boy had ever refused her request before. Chen Guiliang's firm "no" had completely thrown her for a loop.

After a moment's thought, she decided that Chen Guiliang's attitude also made him a suitable deskmate. So, Bian Guanyue turned to Guan Zhiqiang and said, "Excuse me, could we switch seats?"

Guan Zhiqiang's brain had a long reaction time. He was stunned for a few seconds before he came to his senses and grinned foolishly at the girl. "Huh? Oh, okay."

With that, the guy started packing up his things to move.

He gathered his textbooks, test papers, novel, schoolbag, and workbooks all at once and carried them over to Li Jun's side, grinning foolishly. "Hehe, we're deskmates again."

Li Jun muttered with a gloomy expression, "Only an idiot would want to be your deskmate."

Guan Zhiqiang turned back and grinned foolishly at Chen Guiliang. "Hero Chen, Li Jun is calling you an idiot."

Chen Guiliang turned a deaf ear, not bothering to stoop to the level of these two morons.

He suddenly remembered something and finally looked up at Bian Guanyue. "Just a reminder."

"What is it?" Bian Guanyue asked.

Chen Guiliang said, "You'd better switch the desks too."

Bian Guanyue asked in confusion, "Why?"

Chen Guiliang pointed at the desk Guan Zhiqiang had left behind. "On this desk, who knows where the old boogers are hidden. The Guan classmate who just moved, not only does he drool when he reads novels, but he also likes to pick his nose."

Bian Guanyue felt a wave of nausea. She had just put her schoolbag on the desk, and now she quickly picked it up again.

The schoolbag was no longer pure. She planned to get a new one.

Bian Guanyue carried her schoolbag to switch desks, and Guan Zhiqiang agreed with a cheerful smile.

Li Jun was still trying to be attentive. "Classmate Bian, I'm strong, let me help you move it."

"No need," Bian Guanyue refused again.

(Old Wang has never met Yueguan in person, nor has he chatted with him online. The female protagonist has absolutely no connection to Yueguan. In the comment section and chapter discussions of this book, it's best not to joke about other authors. I don't mind, but it won't look good if the author who is mentioned sees it.)
